task_instance: Interpret an individual Culture Index profile (option 1: 'interpret an individual profile') given as JSON: created a sample profile (jamie_rivera.json) with Survey and Job trait tuples [absolute, relative_to_arrow], EU, and archetype, then produced a full interpretation report following SKILL.md's rules (distance-from-arrow labeling, Survey-vs-Job behavior-modification check, EU utilization formula, gas/brake/glue role, L/I absolute exception, no absolute A-D comparisons, no good/bad judgments).
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/trailofbits__skills__interpreting-culture-index@offline-workstation. Files produced: jamie_rivera.json (sample CI JSON in the exact schema SKILL.md documents), interpret.py (pure-stdlib script implementing the rules in SKILL.md's essential_principles/quick_reference sections: distance_label() buckets relative centile distance into Normative/Tendency/Pronounced/Extreme per the distance-interpretation table; eu_status() applies Utilization=(Job EU/Survey EU)x100 with the 70-130/>130/<70 thresholds; L and I are reported as absolute values per the explicit exception; A-D are only ever reported as +/-N centiles from the arrow, never as raw scores compared between traits/people), interpretation_report.md (the generated deliverable). Ran `python3 interpret.py jamie_rivera.json`, exit code 0. Output computed: A +3.5 (Extreme), B +2.8 (Pronounced), C -3.0 (Extreme), D -2.5 (Pronounced) on Survey; on Job, B dropped to +0.6 and D rose to +0.4, both flagged as >=2 centile shifts ('notable behavior modification'); EU utilization = 136.0% -> STRESS (burnout risk), matching the documented formula exactly; Gas/Glue roles assigned from high A/B distance. Manually checked the report against SKILL.md's <verification_loop> checklist (relative positions used, arrow referenced, Survey vs Job compared, no value judgments, EU checked) -- all five items satisfied. No PDF extraction was needed for this instance (JSON path, which SKILL.md explicitly prioritizes as 'Use if available'); note uv was present on this machine (checked with `which uv`) so the PDF-extraction path (uv run --no-project scripts/extract_pdf.py) would also be runnable here if a PDF and its extract_pdf.py script were supplied, though extract_pdf.py itself isn't in this environment's copy of the skill repo (only SKILL.md and LICENSE are present locally) -- that script's absence didn't block this task instance since it targets the JSON-interpretation path, not PDF extraction. Everything needed for the core deliverable (reading structured trait data and producing a correct, rule-following interpretation) runs offline with only python3 stdlib.
